title: Gemini grounded-answer completion at 900 versus 2048 output tokens
metrics: Explicit MAX_TOKENS stop rate where provider metadata is available
Human-confirmed near-budget abrupt completion lower bound for the legacy run

decisionRule.reliability: Accept 2048 for the runtime only if all 27 calls complete without errors or MAX_TOKENS and the known 900-token Rust regression ends naturally.
decisionRule.quality: Do not infer a quality improvement from completion, length, cost, or latency. Preserve a blinded human-review package for the calibration subset and defer broader quality automation until the judge is calibrated.
decisionRule.historicalResults: Do not replace or reinterpret the frozen 900-token generator-model comparison. This experiment evaluates an operational runtime budget only.

amendments.change: Count finish-reason coverage only when a string-valued provider stop reason is present.
amendments.reason: The first report incorrectly counted missing legacy fields as covered because undefined is not equal to null. This reporting-only correction makes the frozen 900-token coverage zero, as stated in the preregistered limitation.
